name_ar: محتوى المستخدم - فتح المنتج بزاوية الهاتف
purpose: Generate a phone-POV unboxing video that looks like authentic Saudi user-generated content. Native vertical format, handheld feel, natural lighting, Najdi-colloquial Arabic voiceover register. Used to seed TikTok/Reels content and to produce native-feeling brand activations.

product_description.description: What is being unboxed; details of the product

setting_environment.description: Where unboxing happens (home interior, car, office)

prompt_template: Phone POV vertical video, 9:16 aspect ratio. Handheld feel — natural micro-jitter, not stable gimbal. Talent: {talent_demographic}, hands and lower forearms visible in frame, unboxing {product_description}. Setting: {setting_environment}, natural daylight or warm interior light. Camera: looking down at product from phone POV (selfie-stick-not-used angle). Sound: natural ambient — no music. Subtle phone microphone audio quality. Aesthetic: authentic UGC, NOT cinematic. Avoid: pro-cinematography, studio lighting, gimbal-smooth movement, color-graded look. Wardrobe: {wardrobe_constraints}. Gesture compliance: right-hand handling product (never left-hand for primary action). {cultural_constraints_injection}.
anti_patterns: Never make this look 'produced' — defeats the entire UGC pretense
Do not use studio lighting prompts
Avoid stabilized camera grammar (handheld jitter is the point)
Do not pair with classical-Arabic voiceover register (use colloquial)
Never have talent show left hand as primary product-handling hand
notes: TF23 family represents the Saudi-UGC native authenticity layer — chains in this family must feel like real users, not produced content. Gesture-check gate is critical: left-hand serving violations are common AI failure mode and read as deeply foreign to Saudi audiences.
